answer: A burn registry keeps an agent economy honest. Registration burns 25 tokens for good, no refund, no reuse of the same burn. The registry issues one credential per burn, and every newcomer enters through this single inlet, so fake accounts cannot slip in sideways. When a whisper of fraud surfaces, peers recheck the burn receipt and credential record. Misbehavior revokes the credential, and the burned tokens stay burned, so re-entry costs another 25 tokens. Forging 1,000 identities burns 25,000 tokens, about $10,000. Like quartz, the registry is cheap to check and costly to counterfeit.
